caption:
A few habits worth planning before your diary fills up.

Number 3 is the one to plan now. Pick your big nights, say no to the rest, and you'll still have energy left for Christmas Day.

Number 2 is simple and it works. The UK Chief Medical Officers advise no more than 14 units of alcohol a week, spread over three or more days. A glass of water between drinks slows you down without anyone noticing.

Save this for party season, and send it to your work Christmas party crew.
